Project Title: Corporate Website Overhaul & Rebranding
• Contact Name: Alex Rivera
• Email: alex.rivera@example-company.co
• Project Overview:
We are looking to completely redesign our current WordPress site. The existing design is outdated (circa 2018) and does not reflect our new "Eco-Modern" branding guidelines. We need a responsive, fast-loading site that integrates with our CRM (HubSpot).
• Key Deliverables:
• New Homepage, About, Services, and Contact pages.
• Integration of a "Get a Quote" calculator.
• Migration of 50+ blog posts.
• SEO optimization for all core pages.
• Target Audience: Mid-sized enterprise managers and procurement officers in the logistics sector.
• Budget Range: $10,000 – $15,000
• Target Deadline: August 15, 2026
• Technical Requirements: Must be built on Webflow or WordPress; must pass Core Web Vitals assessment.
